Check your pay period

Free, and it runs on your own device. No account, nothing sent anywhere, and no way for us to contact your employer even if we wanted to. It takes about two minutes with your stub in front of you.

Before you start

You need your hours for the period, the rate on your stub, and any bonus you were paid that week. The bonus matters more than anything else here: it changes the rate every overtime hour should have been paid at, and that rate appears on no document you receive. If a day is missing, leave it blank.

Your pay period

Two weeks to start. Add more if your period is longer. Everything below happens in this page.

What this is and is not

It is arithmetic. It multiplies your hours by the rate California required and names the section that says so, and it will tell you when the answer comes out right, which is worth knowing too.

It is not advice, and it has not seen your schedule agreement, your union contract or anything your employer would say. It cannot tell you whether to do anything. What it can do is hand you a number you did not have, which is the thing standing between most people and any of the rest of it.
